records.claim: Birth defects can happen in any pregnancy for different reasons. Out of all babies born each year, about 3 out of 100 (3%) will have a birth defect. We look at research studies to try to understand if an exposure, like fluticasone, might increase the chance of birth defects in a pregnancy. Studies show that taking fluticasone, whether inhaled, used as a nasal spray, or used topically, is not expected to increase the chance of birth defects.
records.source_section: Does taking fluticasone increase the chance of birth defects?
